title: AgentsChanged
description:
`topos agents remove` — the describe (`applied: false`) and the applied receipt.
**INFERRED** (additive-only).

agents.description: The pick after the change (as the file would spell it).

applied.description: `false` = the describe: nothing has changed yet.

hooks.description: The auto-update hook files that leave (describe) or left (applied).

kept.description: Copies with local edits kept in place (an edited copy is the person's own work).

pick_path.description: The pick file, as a person reads it.

removed_dirs.description: The skill copies that leave (describe) or left (applied), one folder each.

removed_files.description: The MCP config files the leaving agents' entries leave (describe) or left (applied).

untouched.description: Folders the leaving agents read that STAY, because another picked agent reads them too.
